about: What the installer may install, in order of preference: the first model whose needs the machine meets. Each file is a pinned file of reference/<pin>/model.json, fetched at the pin's revision and kept only if its size and SHA-256 match. engine/tools/gen_catalog.mjs writes this, with the pins, into the engine as engine/src/catalog.c, which `vitna-anchor plan` reads.

models.title: Qwen3-30B-A3B at Q4_K_M
models.note: A 30B mixture of experts, in Qwen's own Q4_K_M quantization, for chat and for coding agents, with its reasoning and tool calls in each API's shape.

models.title: SmolLM2-360M-Instruct
models.note: A small model for trying the server, not a coding assistant. It runs on the CPU, on one thread.
